emailTemplate.subject: Login from a new location
emailTemplate.body:
Hello,

We noticed a login to your {APP_NAME} account from a new location.

If this was you, you may disregard this email.

If this wasn't you, you should immediately change your {APP_NAME} account password to revoke access from all other locations.

Thanks,
{APP_NAME} team

emailTemplate.subject: OTP for {APP_NAME}
emailTemplate.body:
Hello,

If you didn't ask for the one-time password, you can ignore this email.

Thanks,
{APP_NAME} team

name: activeSurgeons
viewQuery: SELECT id,name,department,created,updated FROM surgeons WHERE disabled = FALSE

name: otDayMonths
viewQuery:
SELECT 
  (strftime('%Y', date) || '-' || strftime('%m', date)) as id,
  strftime('%Y', date) as year,
  cast(strftime('%m', date) as integer) as month,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM otDays
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date), strftime('%m', date)
ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC

name: otDayYears
viewQuery:
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y', date) as id,
  strftime('%Y', date) as year,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM otDays
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date)
ORDER BY year DESC

name: upcomingOtDays
viewQuery: SELECT id,date,otList,disabled,remarks,created,updated FROM `otDays` WHERE DATE(date) >= DATE('now', COALESCE((SELECT printf('%+d minutes', utcOffsetMinutes) FROM `appSettings` LIMIT 1), '+0 minutes')) ORDER BY DATE(date) ASC;
